changelog:
Shenzhen Zhongkao Enrollment Assistant 1.3.0 – Initial Release

- Provides full-process Shenzhen Zhongkao policy lookup, voluntary school selection strategy, and admission score reference.
- Offers detailed guidance for talent-based (arts/sports) and independent admissions, including special “score lowering into top schools” strategies.
- Supports comparison of public/private schools, customized recommendation by simulated score, and indicator student/admission policy explanation.
- Generates structured reports on school matching, with emphasis on up-to-date official sources and user safety warnings.
- Designed for Shenzhen junior high students and their parents; usage triggered by common Zhongkao-related queries.
